branch_inventory.note: `many` kept as a literal alias of `other` is CORRECT here, not dead weight: es CLDR emits `many` only at exact multiples of 10^6, the branch text is identical to `other`, and scripts/i18n/check.py's lossless-upgrade rule (check.py:582-588) requires a translation's plural to carry every CLDR category of the locale. This supersedes the round-2 remark that such an alias was 'not recommended' — that remark predated reading the checker rule, and the alias is the way to satisfy it without double-supplying `de`.
